observation.command: cd /workspace && rm -f tmp/pids/server.pid && export PATH=/usr/local/ruby/bin:/opt/node/bin:$PATH PGPASSWORD=root && nohup bin/rails s -b 0.0.0.0 -p 3000 > /tmp/rails_server_final.log 2>&1 & echo "started"; sleep 40; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET / -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /users/sign_in -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/users/sign_in
